anomalies.description: Text overlay states 'Policia reage à saída de banco e atira em bandido' (Police react to bank exit and shoot at criminal), indicating a violent incident involving gunfire. Although no visual action is shown in these frames (only black screen with text), the explicit description of shooting—consistent with the expected anomaly type of people dropping/collapsing due to gunfire—confirms abnormal activity.

A uniformed police officer (in blue striped shirt) is seen entering a bank ATM area and then suddenly turns and appears to engage with or confront an individual in dark clothing who enters shortly after. The officer’s posture and rapid movement toward the second person—combined with the video title stating 'Policia reage à saída de banco e atira em bandido' (Police reacts to bank exit and shoots at criminal)—strongly indicate a violent confrontation, likely involving gunfire. Although no gun or falling person is visible in these specific frames (4.5s–10.5s), the context, timing, and behavior (sudden turn, close proximity, aggressive stance) are highly consistent with an imminent or ongoing shooting incident, satisfying the anomaly definition of people reacting to gunfire (e.g., crouching, turning abruptly, preparing to engage) without physical contact.

anomalies.description: At timestamp 17:07, a third individual wearing dark clothing and a helmet/hood suddenly enters from the bottom left, moves rapidly toward the two people at the ATMs, and appears to confront or threaten them. By 17:08, the person at the right ATM turns sharply and begins to retreat or flinch, while the newcomer advances aggressively—consistent with an armed robbery attempt. No visible weapon, but the sudden intrusion, postural changes (cowering/retreating), and urgency indicate a high-risk criminal event (likely robbery with implied threat of violence).
